title: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 1/2 in. Hammer Drill
description: The M18 FUEL 1/2 in. Hammer Drill is the Industry's Most Powerful Drill delivering Up to 60% More Power, is Up To 1.5 in. Shorter length and delivers Up To 2X Faster Speed Under Heavy Load. The POWERSTATE Brushless motor delivers 1,200 in-lbs of torque and 2,000 RPMs providing fast drilling through demanding applications. At 6.9 in. in length this is the most compact drill in its class allowing better access into tight spaces.

title: Arbor Spot Resist Stainless One-Handle Pulldown Kitchen Faucet
description: The Arbor line's smooth profile is tailored to perfection. The slight flair of the handle and the curve of the spout make this a transitional look that works with a variety of decorating styles. Equipped with the Reflex system for smooth operation, easy movement and secure docking of the pulldown/pullout spray head.

title: Bosch 18V Compact 1/2 In. Drill/Driver Kit
description: This Bosch drill/driver kit provides a tool that features 480 In.-Lbs. of torque, for a wealth of professional applications. At only 2.8 Lbs. (tool only, not including battery) and 7.8 In. long, the GSR18V-190 is a compact drill that provides outstanding maneuverability.
